mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as rising policy rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with month-over-month FEDFUNDS increases, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recessionary expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as stagflationary pressures intensify.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increasing, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as strengthening supply chains support corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with month-over-month INDPRO increases, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 8.0%, it signals persistent inflation that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to aggressive monetary policy expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 8.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0% QoQ, it signals strong economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of quarters with GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as cross-sector economic strength boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of months with both HOUST and INDPRO increasing, or Rank IC over last 3 years < 0.03.
